exact_coverage_reason: The combined Level-0 Drive + Project-Frankenstein + reconciliation atomic-obligation denominator remains unfrozen; this targeted shard must not manufacture exact completion credit.

historical Drive Retina learned-dictionary/prototype lineage and negative results

mechanism_findings.finding: Project-Frankenstein FrankEye merges a Retina-v8 CNN, DINOv2 scene features, HOG/color features, OCR, face detection and optional GoL dynamics into a CPU-local inference pipeline. The CNN is explicitly inference-only and lazy-loads a saved external retina_v8.pt artifact.
mechanism_findings.implication: Project-Frankenstein preserved operational Retina integration and low-latency feature reuse, but not an online user-adaptive visual learner.

mechanism_findings.finding: The integrated classifier uses saved class metadata with a CIFAR-10 fallback, softmax top-k ranking and no in-process prototype memory, class admission, per-user learner state or candidate-vs-current update loop.
mechanism_findings.implication: Fixed-class CNN confidence must not be misread as the current KNOWN/UNKNOWN familiarity contract.

mechanism_findings.finding: FrankEye DINOv2 computes reusable patch-token scene descriptors such as complexity, spatial attention, uniformity, center focus and salient-region count, but the frozen-head code consumes them only for description generation rather than persistent user-specific prototype learning.
mechanism_findings.implication: DINO features are a concrete candidate frozen backbone for the current MVC baseline, subject to measured hardware cost and open-set discrimination.

mechanism_findings.finding: Optional GoL processing in Project-Frankenstein performs per-image evolution statistics for descriptive output. The frozen-head analysis path does not apply the historical Drive Retina learned GoL dictionary/centroid matching mechanism recovered in the earlier Level-0 receipt.
mechanism_findings.implication: The Drive learned-dictionary lineage and Project-Frankenstein FrankEye lineage diverged: PF integrated Retina perception while dropping or externalizing the adaptive dictionary mechanism. This is a material cross-source lineage fact to preserve.

mechanism_findings.finding: Project-Frankenstein feature_trainer treats FrankEye as fixed project feature ground truth (local Retina CNN + GOLPU/features + OCR + face detection) and trains Frank's self-knowledge about that capability. This training is cognitive feature self-knowledge, not visual classifier personalization.
mechanism_findings.implication: Do not count feature_trainer as evidence that the visual subsystem itself learned user-specific visual classes.

cross_source_reconciliation.historical_drive_retina: Contained a two-tier synthetic + learned GoL pattern library and offline dictionary/replay iteration, an ancestor of prototype/centroid familiarity routing.
cross_source_reconciliation.project_frankenstein_frozen_head: Operationalized Retina/FrankEye as a unified local inference pipeline with reusable CNN/DINO/handcrafted features, but with fixed saved weights/classes and no visible online per-user adaptive learner state transition.
cross_source_reconciliation.current_frank_v0_1_contract: Requires bounded cyclic user-specific learning, trusted example admission, calibrated open-set outcomes, candidate promotion/rejection/rollback, replay/versioning and explicit resource budgets.
cross_source_reconciliation.lineage_conclusion: The current Micro Visual Classifier should be treated as a synthesis/extension of two partially separated historical lines: PF's fast integrated perception backbone plus Drive Retina's learned-dictionary/prototype/replay concepts. Neither historical line alone satisfies the current contract.

negative_results_and_guardrails: No evidence in the inspected frozen-head FrankEye path supports claiming online user-specific visual learning.
No evidence in the inspected path supports treating softmax top-k confidence as calibrated open-set familiarity.

The presence of a configured _GOLPU_LIBRARY path is not evidence that learned dictionary matching participates in the final analyzed path; the inspected analyze flow uses _gol_evolve dynamics for deep description and returns prose.
Project-Frankenstein feature self-training must not be conflated with sensor/vision-model training.
Historical Drive Retina coverage gains remain measurement lineage, not proof that the PF integrated path inherited those gains.

recommended_discriminating_tests: At H1, benchmark MVC-0 nearest-centroid prototypes on the same frozen DINO features already available in the PF lineage versus the historical GoL-signature centroid family and a small linear head.

Use recurring user-specific classes plus visually similar OOD/near-neighbor negatives; preregister known-class accuracy, open-set AUROC/FPR at target recall, calibration, sequential retention, CPU/RAM/update cost and routing savings.
Lesion the adaptive state while holding the PF perception backbone fixed to measure the learner's incremental causal benefit instead of attributing backbone performance to adaptation.
